It was selected to compete for the Golden Bear at the 66th Berlin International Film Festival.

It stars Kirsten Dunst, Lizzy Caplan and Isla Fisher as three troubled women who reunite for the wedding of a friend (played by Rebel Wilson) who was ridiculed in high school.
